from qiskit_aer import Aer
from qiskit_algorithms import VQE, Estimator
from qiskit_algorithms.optimizers import SLSQP
from qiskit_circuit.library import EfficientSU2
from qiskit_nature.second_q.drivers import PySCFDriver
from qiskit_nature.second_q.drivers import UnitsType
from qiskit_nature.second_q.transformers import ActiveSpaceTransformer
from qiskit_nature.second_q.mappers import JordanWignerMapper
from qiskit_nature.second_q.problems import ElectronicStructureProblem
from qiskit_nature.second_q.circuit.library import UCCSD, HartreeFock
from qiskit_nature.second_q.transformers import FreezeCoreTransformer
from qiskit_nature.second_q.properties import ElectronicEnergy
from qiskit_nature.second_q.formats.qubit_converter import QubitConverter
from qiskit_nature.second_q.formats import QMolecule
from qiskit_nature.second_q.formats import Molecule
import numpy as np

def vqe_n2_sto3g_cas66():
    # Define the molecule
    molecule = Molecule(
        geometry=[("N", (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)), ("N", (0.0, 0.0, 1.098))],
        charge=0,
        multiplicity=1,
    )
    
    # Define the driver
    driver = PySCFDriver.from_molecule(
        molecule=molecule,
        basis="sto3g",
        unit=UnitsType.ANGSTROM,
    )
    
    # Get the electronic structure problem
    electronic_structure_problem = ElectronicStructureProblem(driver)
    
    # Apply transformations
    freeze_core_transformer = FreezeCoreTransformer(freeze_core=True, remove_orbitals=None)
    active_space_transformer = ActiveSpaceTransformer(num_electrons=6, num_molecular_orbitals=6)
    transformers = [freeze_core_transformer, active_space_transformer]
    transformed_problem = electronic_structure_problem.transform(transformers)
    
    # Get the Hamiltonian
    second_q_ops = transformed_problem.second_q_ops()
    main_op = second_q_ops[0]
    
    # Convert to qubits using Jordan-Wigner mapping
    qubit_converter = QubitConverter(JordanWignerMapper())
    qubit_op = qubit_converter.convert(main_op, num_particles=electronic_structure_problem.num_particles)
    
    # Define the ansatz
    ansatz = EfficientSU2(qubit_op.num_qubits, reps=1, entanglement="linear")
    
    # Define the optimizer
    optimizer = SLSQP(maxiter=100)
    
    # Define the VQE
    aer_simulator = Aer.get_backend("aer_simulator")
    estimator = Estimator(aer_simulator)
    vqe = VQE(estimator=estimator, ansatz=ansatz, optimizer=optimizer)
    
    # Run the VQE
    result = vqe.compute_minimum_eigenvalue(qubit_op)
    
    # Get the ground state energy estimate
    ground_state_energy_estimate = result.eigenvalue.real
    
    # Define the reference energy (from PySCF)
    reference_energy = -108.59452449
    
    # Calculate the energy error
    energy_error_against_reference = abs(ground_state_energy_estimate - reference_energy)
    
    # Check chemical accuracy achievement
    chemical_accuracy_achievement = energy_error_against_reference < 1e-6
    
    # Calculate measurement cost, qubit count, circuit depth, and gate count
    measurement_cost = qubit_op.num_qubits
    qubit_count = qubit_op.num_qubits
    circuit_depth = ansatz.depth()
    gate_count = ansatz.count_ops()["cx"]
    
    return {
        "ground_state_energy_estimate": ground_state_energy_estimate,
        "energy_error_against_reference": energy_error_against_reference,
        "chemical_accuracy_achievement": chemical_accuracy_achievement,
        "measurement_cost": measurement_cost,
        "qubit_count": qubit_count,
        "circuit_depth": circuit_depth,
        "gate_count": gate_count
    }
